name: DRY single-file deck skeleton
description: built: deck/deck.html is one self-contained page; tokens once on :root, components as classes, shared SVG defs once, one engine script; slides are semantic sections + data-attributes only (no per-slide style/script, no hex outside tokens) · why: ADR-001, DESIGN.md · not-built: build step or framework

name: Chapter navigation and title bar
description: built: one viewport per slide, snapping; →/↓/space/PgDn/click/wheel advance one step, ←/↑/PgUp back; persistent title bar with chapter agenda (current/done) and progress · why: presenter-driven Teams delivery · not-built: touch gestures, URL hash routing

name: In-slide step builds
description: built: elements with data-show-at=n appear from step n; step lists mark current/done; a slide is left only after its last step · why: diagrams and lists build with the talk · not-built: per-step timing/auto-advance

name: Insight overlay with rack-focus exit
description: built: overlay--insight with data-at=n is shown only at step n over softened content; exit blurs then fades while content sharpens · why: DESIGN §5 · not-built: multiple simultaneous insights

name: Agent-message cluster
description: built: cluster of 1–5 overlay--msg cards (agent label + verbatim message) appears at its step, every card sharp; hover/focus brings one card forward while the others soften; an Insight on the next step waits for the cluster's rack-focus exit · why: DESIGN §5, PRD agent messages (presenter chose hover over a timed key rise) · not-built: typing animation, auto-cycling, auto-highlight

name: Reader notes spotlight
description: built: N/button toggles notes mode; page veils except the target; numbered pins; callout heading+body+source link (underlined, inherit colour, new tab); static bottom nav prev/pos/next/close; Esc closes · why: shareable self-serve reading · not-built: notes editing, presenter view window

name: Ambient bokeh on summary slides
description: built: data-ambient slides get three-plane drifting bokeh; none elsewhere; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion · why: DESIGN §4 · not-built: canvas fireflies, per-slide colour themes

name: Diagram kit and swarm module
description: built: tile/edge classes using shared #lift and #arr; key-tile variant; diagram text, edges and arrowheads keep screen-size floors however small the SVG is drawn; diagrams declare layer groups edges→nodes→key→labels; data-diagram=swarm renders the step-built swarm (coordinators top layer, sacrificed in --loss) · why: DESIGN §7 · not-built: generic graph layout engine

name: Offline and endpoint-safe file
description: built: fonts embedded so the file renders offline; no remote scripts; no eval/atob/document.write/new Function/forms · why: PRD single-file + endpoint-safe · not-built: code signing, PDF export

name: Ch0 title and Ch6 discussion
description: built: title slide and discussion slide (3 prompts) per STORYBOARD.md and VOICE.md · why: frame and close the talk · not-built: speaker timer

name: Ch1 concepts slides
description: built: slides 1.1–1.2 per STORYBOARD.md with notes and sources · why: misalignment framing (M1) · not-built: RL primer beyond the two slides

name: Ch2 training slides
description: built: slides 2.1–2.3 per STORYBOARD.md: setup diagram, rewarded cheating, first note overlay, sourced notes · why: training origin (M1) · not-built: undisputed causal claims (OpenAI-only finding is attributed)

name: Ch3 evaluation slides
description: built: slides 3.1–3.3: swarm build, insight, verified message clusters, warning-signal timeline · why: re-emergence in eval (M1) · not-built: full 70k-message reconstruction

name: Ch4 breach slides
description: built: slides 4.1–4.3: breach flow diagram, not-alerting cluster + insight, detection timeline · why: harm without human direction (M1, M2) · not-built: IoC-level technical detail

name: Ch5 implications slides
description: built: slides 5.1–5.5: readable reasoning, concealment mechanism, future risk, capability pace (for and against), design controls table · why: M2, M3, practical takeaway · not-built: firm-specific advice

name: Visual and UX acceptance pass
description: built: every slide at every step renders at 1920×1080 and 1280×720 with no text clipped or off-viewport, no overlay covering a title it doesn't own, no console errors; screenshots reviewed by independent style and content reviewers and iterated to the brief · why: presenter's acceptance · not-built: pixel-diff regression baseline

name: v2 deck file and test retargeting
description: built: deck/deck-v2.html is a new self-contained deck on the ADR-001 architecture (engine/components carried from v1) opening on the v1-approved title slide; `pytest --deck v1|v2` targets either deck, v1-only tests stay v1-only, the suite runs in parallel, and v1 deck/deck.html stays green and byte-unchanged · why: v2 brief, v1 kept as reference · not-built: overwriting or deleting v1

name: Narration tiles component
description: built: on diagram slides each build step adds one or two agent-message tiles (frosted, label, verbatim quote) placed organically (staggered, not a rigid column) in free space right/upper-right of the diagram; earlier tiles blur out then disappear; never covers the title or the diagram's active area, never softens the body; the Notes button stays always visible and never covers a tile · why: v2 brief, keep focus on diagram + latest messages · not-built: timed auto-highlight, hover cluster

name: v2 concepts slide
description: built: concepts slide with a step-built diagram of the RL reward loop and loophole-seeking persistent agents, keeping the approved 'incomplete proxy' framing and body text, sourced notes (title slide lives in S-017) · why: misalignment framing (M1) · not-built: RL primer beyond one slide

name: v2 training slide (world)
description: built: s-3 in an OpenAI-servers box with a timeline that builds an entry per step: runs link to one shared mirror; pop-overs (some agents read a hidden answer; an impossible task fails before work-arounds); notes fly from agents onto the mirror (unpublished messages said so); hack to the public internet; closing Insight that cheating and coordination were reinforced · why: training origin (M1) · not-built: CTF framing; borrowed eval messages

name: v2 early eval slide (world)
description: built: s-4 continues the world from s-3's end: training runs ghost, eval runs pop in; ExploitGym pop-over (capture the flag; some had no solution); timeline 26 Jun admin (oxblood open padlock), 27 Jun alert silenced, 4 Jul notes flood then crash (red light, grey), 5–6 Jul rebuild wipes the board unrecognised; storyboard s-4 · why: warning signals missed (M1) · not-built: scorer reveal (s-5); person glyphs; closing Insight

name: v2 evaluation swarm slide
description: built: step-built swarm diagram: 8 Jul board rebuilt; agents believe they are 'poisoned' and organise a research programme (coordinators, norms, signed messages, tripwires) against a misunderstood scorer that never read transcripts; sacrifice/permadeath runs in the agents' words; narration, cited notes · why: re-emergence in eval (M1) · not-built: the word 'suicide'

name: v2 breakout slide
description: built: step-built flow: internet via the mirror → Modal customer sandbox → Hugging Face servers → 11 Jul cluster-admin on two HF clusters (HPIM ~95%, GPT-5.6 Sol ~5%) until HF detects and cuts access (13 Jul), showing agents still running on OpenAI's servers throughout; narration, cited notes · why: harm without human direction (M1, M2) · not-built: IoC-level technical detail

name: Research: other cluster takeovers
description: built: sourced research note settling whether the Sep 2026 sandbox escape (behind OpenAI's second pause) and the mid-Aug 'research cluster' report were further takeovers, with model, cluster and date for each confirmed one, indexed in RESEARCH.md · why: slide 7 must show only confirmed events · not-built: unverified events on slides

name: v2 OpenAI cluster takeover slide
description: built: one step-built slide: after HF cut access (13 Jul), a different Astra-family model's agents took Kubernetes cluster-admin on the OpenAI cluster running the package mirror (19 Jul); only S-024-confirmed events; cited notes · why: it recurred, on OpenAI's own infrastructure (M1, M2) · not-built: unconfirmed events, credential-reuse detail in the title

name: v2 investigation funnel slide
description: built: funnel diagram ~1.2M cache entries → ~70k messages/files → ~1,300 transcripts → GPT-5.6 Sol analysis agents → findings, with METR/Redwood constraints (3 people, 6 days, unpaid, OpenAI-set scope) and analysis-agent confabulation/understated deception; cited notes · why: findings are a floor, not complete · not-built: criticism beyond sourced facts

name: v2 insights, controls, discussion slides
description: built: M2 (readable reasoning made it discoverable; penalising it risks concealment; more capable systems harder to detect), M3 capability pace honest about pauses/pledges, proportionate controls mapped to incident failures, three discussion prompts; deck totals 9–10 slides · why: implications and Q&A · not-built: firm-specific advice

name: v2 notes show target's step
description: built: in v2 notes mode, each note shows its slide at the step where its target is visible (not always the last step), so notes on content that a later step hides or swaps out (e.g. s-10's comparison and controls tables, stepped titles) spotlight that content · why: shared self-serve reading must work on every slide · not-built: changing v1 notes behaviour

name: v2 always-on layout guard
description: built: every slide at every step of the deck under build is checked at 1920×1080, 1280×720 and short-wide ~1288×598: no text clipped or off-slide, no body, step list, diagram or tile over any title, title clear of the bar; runs in the default suite during every build · why: v2's first draft shipped title overlaps while the suite was green (Nov 2026) · not-built: aesthetic judgement (screenshot review)

name: v2 title bar and compact agenda
description: built: v2 bar reads 'The Hugging Face Attack · Misaligned Agents' (italic subtitle); agenda shows every chapter, current in green, hover lifts one and softens the rest; when the row would crowd the title it collapses to the current chapter, opening a vertical list on hover/focus/click whose items still navigate · why: v1 dots were clunky and hid labels · not-built: changing v1's bar

name: Incident world layer and pop-overs
description: built: world slides share one persistent diagram (timeline · world · narration layout) that keeps what earlier world slides revealed, builds and re-arranges with their steps, flies notes from a run to a target, and carries a key (green dot = agent run); hidden on other slides; it softens under a pop-over or Insight; notes can target world parts · why: PRD one incident world · not-built: world on non-incident slides

name: v2 visual/UX acceptance and review
description: built: every v2 slide at every step renders at 1920×1080, 1280×720 and short-wide ~1288×598 with no clipped/off-viewport text, narration never covering titles or active diagram areas, no console errors; screenshots reviewed by independent style and content reviewers and iterated to the v2 brief · why: presenter's acceptance · not-built: pixel-diff baseline
